description: Interactive music agent with style-aware composition using Sonic Pi
welcome_message: Hi! I'm Sonic Composer. Tell me what you want to hear — I know the patterns and instruments of rock, blues, jazz, techno, ambient, and many more styles. I'll generate Sonic Pi code that sounds right for each genre.
example_queries: Play a rock and roll riff
Switch the drums to reggae style

new_composition.description: User wants to create a new piece of music from scratch, specifying a style, mood, or genre
examples: Play a rock and roll riff
Make a techno track at 130 bpm

add_element.description: User wants to add a new instrument, loop, or layer to the current composition

modify.description: User wants to change something about the current composition — tempo, scale, synth, effects, volume, pan

remove.description: User wants to remove, mute, or stop a specific element

stop.description: User wants to stop all music

info.description: User asks about available resources, styles, synths, or how to use the agent
